notes.title: Pirates Bay Demo UPDATE 1.3!
notes.notes:
General:

 Added 3 new characters: Ninja, Samurai and Ronin.
 Added 2 new weapons: Short Katana and Long Katana.
 Added a new boss - Possessed Samurai.


Minor Improvements:

 Now all sellers have all weapons in stock.
 Firearm damage has been significantly increased.
 Balanced the defense of melee weapons.
 The game size has been significantly reduced.
 Optimization improvements.


Bug Fixes and Tweaks:

 Fixed a bug during battles with bosses when they stopped attacking the player.
 Fixed a bug with ladders on ships where they could not be used.

notes.title: Pirates Bay Demo Patch 1.2.2
notes.notes:
General:

 New sound manager, now the music plays constantly and does not suddenly stop!
 Added notification messages and sounds at the end of quests.


Minor Improvements:

 Fixed a delay at the start and end of steering the ship.


Bug Fixes and Tweaks:

 Fixed misses on bosses when using ranged weapons.

notes.title: Pirates Bay Demo Patch 1.2.1
notes.notes:
General:

 Added zoom for camera.
 In target lock, the character now always looks at the enemy (strafe).
 Melee and ranged weapons have been rebalanced.
 Bosses have been rebalanced.


Minor Improvements:

 Recolored character selection buttons in the collection.
 Added hint to set all sails to achieve maximum speed.


Bug Fixes and Tweaks:

 Fixed small pistol damage.
 Fixed disappearing distance for trees on some islands.

notes.title: Pirates Bay Demo UPDATE 1.2!
notes.notes:
ATTENTION!!! Previous saves do not work in the new version!

General:

 FREE NEW skins are waiting for you in the collection!
 Added hints to the game.
 Expanded the range of weapons at vendors.
 Ships can no longer fly over the islands.
 Sprint no longer spends energy.
 Buying from vendors is simplified.
 Added category icons to the inventory.
 Improved ship customizations vendor window.
 New icons on compass bar.
 Pressing instead of holding to dig chests.
 Optimization improvements.
 UI and graphics updates.


Minor Improvements:

 Treasure crosses are now better visible in all conditions.
 You can no longer walk through the Dragon Head figurehead.
 Soldiers no longer respawn instantly.
 The control list now displays character and ship controls separately.


Bug Fixes and Tweaks:

 Fixed bugs when digging, such as disappearing weapons and animations that do not stop after canceling.
 Fixed bug with mouse wheel scrolling in vendor window.
 Fixed a bug with displaying the amount of ammo.
 Treasure icons on compass bar no longer display distance.

notes.title: Pirates Bay Demo UPDATE 1.1!
notes.notes:
General:

 Added hints to the main menu and quest givers.
 Added respawn button to the pause.
 Continue button is no longer available if you don't have any saves.
 Optimized graphics settings.


Minor Improvements:

 Radius of interaction with ladders on ships increased.
 The quest giver "Crews" has been renamed to "Pirate Gangs" to better reflect the essence of the quests and eliminate misunderstandings.
 Treasure crosses are now visible in the darkness.


Bug Fixes and Tweaks:

 You can no longer swim through the sea bottom.
 Now there are no waves around the islands at any water quality settings.
 Added reflections to the water in the main menu.
 Other minor bug fixes.
